messages:
maria: Observed a slow-residency trend on kv-3031 across 36h leading to an OOM during low traffic. Not a classic burst; more a steady accumulation. Posting notes and proposed split of work.
aj: Can you attach the brief heap snapshot and any caller hotspots?
maria: snapshot: total_live:+360MB over 36h. top sizes: session_blob (~110KB avg), query_cache entries (~28KB). hotspots: prefetch.router -> cache.insert. Fragmentation climbed from 18% to 38%.
zara: i sampled stack traces on canary last night; long-lived allocations come from the reconnect path not honoring TTL in one branch. I'll map exact codepaths.
devin: sounds like "slow leak + fragmentation" class. Suggest we create a CI harness that simulates low-qps repeated writes to a prefix to catch regressions earlier. Owner: qa.
qa: OK i'll build a harness with configurable qps, size distribution, delete rate. Plan: docker runner + nightly job. ETA first cut: 72h.
aj: For closure criteria on incidents: require harness shows no >200MB growth in 48h for 7 nights and fragment_ratio <30%. Also add alert: kv_shard_fragment_ratio >30% for 15m -> page. I'll own dashboard and alert.
maria: short-term mitigation: add ingress TTL enforcement and a per-value cap 2MB gated behind canary. i'll open hotfix PR and roll to 10% canary first. ETA 6h.
zara: profiling deliverables: heap diffs + flamegraphs, top offending keys labeled with likely owners. ETA 24h.
devin: medium/long term: RFC for eviction policy with slab compaction probe (trigger when fragment_ratio >35% for 10m). I'll draft and aim for next planning cycle.
qa: adding harness integration to PR checks that touch prefetch/ingest. Also will add a local emulator mode for contributors.
maria: action items summarized: maria=hotfix ingress TTL + 2MB cap (due: today 18:00 UTC); qa=CI harness + nightly runs (due: +3d); zara=profiler + key owners (due: +1d); aj=dashboard + alert (due: +1d); devin=eviction/compaction RFC (due: +10d).
aj: small UX: when we reject oversized values, respond with x-kv-reject-code:oversized_value and include correlation id.
zara: label the incident class as "slow-residency" so we can track recurrence.
maria: scheduling: short checkpoint in 48h to review hotfix and harness progress. invite will go to maria, aj, devin, zara, qa.
devin: also propose a monthly residency review that correlates harness failures with real incidents and recent PRs touching prefetch/ingest. Owner rotation: infra -> runtime -> devex.
qa: I'll add the harness repo link to the incident ticket and wire CI alerting into Slack.
maria: thanks all, will post these follow-ups into the postmortem and close the incident after 14 days of no recurrence and passing harness runs. 
aj: thanks
